articles.title_en: Der Spiegel: The weapons cache found outside Berlin was left there by a 24-year-old Ukrainian man arrested in Romania

Citing intelligence services, the magazine said he was part of a group preparing acts of sabotage in European countries on orders from Russian intelligence.
